message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. Fact: Wu set fire to his own house (or part) to drive out intruders who were demanding debt from his husband. He used lighter to ignite bedding, causing property damage valued 3068 yuan. This is arson? Under Chinese law, arson of property causing damage is crime of "故意毁坏财物" (intentional damage to property). Also could be "放火罪" (arson) if endangering public safety. The value is low, but still intentional destruction of property. The prosecution cites Article 114 of Criminal Law, which is "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional damage to property). Article 114: Whoever destroys or damages property of others, causing loss, shall be sentenced. So the crime is intentional damage to property. Not arson (Article 132). So answer: 故意毁坏财物.

Check key rules: Must match fact. The fact mentions property damage, not mention endangering public safety. So single crime.

Thus output JSON with reasoning and final answer.
